title: Email and chat
intro: Most work communication is now written: email, Slack, WhatsApp. Write messages that are short, clear, polite and modern.
introBn: এখন অফিসের বেশিরভাগ যোগাযোগই লেখায় — ছোট, পরিষ্কার, আর আধুনিক ইংরেজিতে লিখুন।

units.title: Openings, closings and attachments
units.idea: Modern business email is short, clear and friendly. Open with a greeting and purpose, close with a next step.
units.ideaBn: আধুনিক ইমেইল ছোট, পরিষ্কার, আর বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ।

formula.name: Open
formula.pos: Hi Sara, · Dear Mr Rahman, · I hope you're well. · I'm writing to…

formula.name: Close
formula.pos: Let me know if you have any questions. · I look forward to hearing from you. · Best regards,

uses.ex: I'm writing to confirm our meeting.

uses.rule: Attachments: Please find attached… / I've attached…

uses.ex: I look forward to meeting you.

traps.wrong: I am looking forward to hear from you.
traps.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
Please find the file attached. / I've attached the file.

drills.s: I'm writing ___ about the delivery date.
I look forward to ___ from you.

o: Please find attached the agenda for Monday.
Attached herewith please find the agenda kindly.
drills.a: Please find attached the agenda for Monday.

o: I have attach the revised report.
Revised report is attached by me.

drills.s: Please let me know if you ___ any questions.

units.title: Following up, apologising, updating
units.idea: Follow up politely, apologise clearly without over-apologising, and give updates with the present perfect.
units.ideaBn: ফলো-আপে চাপ না দিয়ে মনে করিয়ে দিন; ক্ষমা চাইলে পরিষ্কার আর সংক্ষিপ্ত।

formula.name: Follow up
formula.pos: Just following up on… · I wanted to check whether… · Any update on…?

formula.name: Apologise
formula.pos: Sorry for the delay. · I apologise for the confusion. · Thanks for your patience.

uses.ex: Just following up on my email from Monday.
I apologise for sending the wrong file.
We've fixed the bug and deployed the update.

uses.rule: Thanks for your patience is better than Sorry again and again.
uses.ex: Thanks for your patience while we sort this out.

traps.wrong: I am apologising for the mistake.
traps.why: Apologise is a performative verb: simple.

drills.s: Just following up ___ the invoice I sent last week.
We ___ the issue. Everything should work now.

drills.q: Pick the best chat message to a manager.
o: Hi Arif, just checking if you had a chance to look at the proposal.
drills.a: Hi Arif, just checking if you had a chance to look at the proposal.

drills.s: Can we ___ a quick call at 3?
drills.x: Hop on a call = join a quick call (informal).

mastery.q: Pick the best subject + first line.
o: Regarding the matter of the meeting kindly.
Meeting moved to Thursday — I'm writing to let you know the new time.
Dear Sir, Respected, I want to inform that
mastery.a: Meeting moved to Thursday — I'm writing to let you know the new time.

mastery.s: Let me know ___ you need anything else.
I look forward to ___ with you.
I ___ the slides. They're in the shared folder.
I wanted to check ___ you received my email.
